name: Nature Communities Fund
summary: Two-year grants for individuals leading community-led habitat creation and restoration projects in public spaces in eight London boroughs, covering their time and project costs, with cohort support. First open call.

amount.note: Two-year grant that funds the grantee's time and project costs.

reporting: Grantees share quarterly light-touch updates, take part in six-monthly progress and cohort reviews, and give an annual evaluation interview.

status.quote: The call for applications is open from 14 October 2026 to 2 December 2026.

applicant_types.quote: this round is for individuals only, but you may apply as an individual that is linked to, or a member of, an organisation

geography.quote: live in or serve a community in one of these London boroughs: Barking and Dagenham, Brent, Hackney, Islington, Lambeth, Lewisham, Newham, Waltham Forest

access.quote: The call for applications is open from 14 October 2026 to 2 December 2026.

window.quote: The call for applications is open from 14 October 2026 to 2 December 2026.

amount.quote: a two-year grant of up to £60,000, with the opportunity to apply for follow-on funding in the third year

reporting.quote: reporting: quarterly light touch information sharing 6-monthly progress sharing and cohort review an annual evaluation interview
